study.preparation: Giant DOPE/DOPC liposomes with encapsulated macromolecules and a fluorescent protein tracer. Sucrose raises the exterior osmolarity.

figure_3.observable: Initial volume divided by final volume, estimated from mean diameters.

figure_S3.observable: Relative GFP concentration and inverse relative volume, tracked on the same liposome for each symbol series.

study.limits: Figure S2 has individual 10-minute inverse volume ratios of roughly 3.3 to 4.9. The plateau summary has no reported standard error. S3 has no pointwise errors. GFP reports a macromolecular tracer. Small-solute retention and deviations from spherical volume reconstruction remain unresolved.

cells_equilibrium_replay.conditions: Two static 64-osmole worlds with identical area, initially isotonic at spherical capacity. No exchange event fires. For this ideal solution one mOsm/L corresponds to one mM of counted particles.
